biography: Fahad AlGhamdi received the Ph.D. degree in computer science from The George Washington University, USA, in 2020. He is an Assistant Professor of Computer Science and Vice Dean for Academic Affairs at Al-Baha University, Saudi Arabia. His research interests include Arabic natural language processing, code-switching, machine learning, large language models, and sentiment and emotion analysis.
